headline: [FIXTURE] Federal student loan interest resets on Dec 1
summary: A fake placeholder story used to test the money Receipt. Federal borrowers would see a higher monthly bill. Private and paid-off borrowers are not covered.

receipts.calc: 1.2 point rate increase on a $18,000–$24,000 balance = $38–$52/mo
receipts.text: Your federal loan payment goes up about $38 to $52 a month starting in December.
receipts.evidence: Borrowers with federal loans will pay between $38 and $52 more each month once the new rate takes effect.

otherwise: Private-loan borrowers and people with no student debt keep the same payment.

headline: [FIXTURE] Washington caps yearly rent increases
summary: A fake placeholder story used to test ask-in-context. A state cap would limit how much rent can rise each year. Non-renters get a rules-only Receipt.

receipts.calc: cap holds the increase to 3% instead of 6% on $1,000–$1,500 rent = $30–$45/mo saved
receipts.text: Your rent can't rise more than the state cap, saving you about $30 to $45 a month.
receipts.evidence: The cap limits annual rent increases to 3 percent, about $30 to $45 a month less than last year's typical increase.

receipts.text: The new rent cap doesn't set your housing cost, but it applies if you rent later.
receipts.evidence: The cap applies only to tenants with a residential lease, not to dorm residents or homeowners.

otherwise: Renters outside Washington are not covered by this cap.

headline: [FIXTURE] New inspection rule for cars registered in Washington
summary: A fake placeholder story used to test the not-affected state. Drivers would need a new inspection at renewal. People who don't drive are unaffected.

receipts.text: You'll need a safety inspection before you renew your car tabs.
receipts.evidence: Drivers must present a completed safety inspection before renewing vehicle registration.

otherwise: Drivers are the only people this rule reaches; transit riders and cyclists are not affected.

headline: [FIXTURE] State student aid applications close Dec 1
summary: A fake placeholder story used to test the deadline Receipt. Enrolled students must apply by the deadline to get the grant. Non-students have nothing to file.

receipts.text: Apply for the state grant by December 1 or you lose it for this year.
receipts.evidence: Applications for the state need grant must be submitted by December 1 to be considered for the current year.

otherwise: People not enrolled in school have no application to file.
